settings.heading: What exactly am I buying?
settings.row_content: A faithfully restored digital reproduction of the historic Stratton Oakmont broker training manual, delivered as a clean, high-resolution PDF. Reproduced for educational and study purposes.

settings.heading: How do I receive it?
settings.row_content: Instantly. After checkout you get an immediate download link. No shipping, no waiting. Read it on any device or print it for your team.

settings.heading: Who is it for?
settings.row_content: Salespeople who want to close with more confidence, founders who sell their own product, and sales leaders looking for a timeless reference to train their team. No prior experience required.

settings.heading: Is this a get-rich-quick thing?
settings.row_content: No. This is a training document about the craft of selling: tonality, persuasion and control. A study of sales psychology, to be applied professionally and ethically. For training purposes only.

settings.heading: Do I need sales experience to use it?
settings.row_content: No. It's written to work on your very next call, whether you're brand new or a seasoned closer. Beginners get a step-by-step system; pros get sharper scripts and cleaner objection-handling.

settings.heading: What format is it, and what can I read it on?
settings.row_content: A clean, high-resolution PDF. Read it on your phone, tablet or laptop, or print it for your desk and your team. Yours to keep forever.

settings.heading: Can I use it to train my whole team?
settings.row_content: Yes. It's built as a reference you can coach from: one proven playbook to bring every rep up to the level of your best one. It's licensed for you and your team's internal use, not for resale or redistribution.

settings.heading: Is this affiliated with Jordan Belfort or the real Stratton Oakmont?
settings.row_content: No. This is an independently produced, faithfully restored reproduction of a historic training document, offered for educational and study purposes. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any person or company.

settings.heading: What will I actually learn?
settings.row_content: The full closing system: cold-calling scripts, fast qualifying, objection-handling, tonality and control, and the Straight Line approach, the same fundamentals that ran a legendary sales floor.

settings.heading: What language is it in?
settings.row_content: Currently English. More languages are on the way.
